Note `fcs /ExFileI/` starting at `$0D`: its final byte, at `$13`, is `C9` -
`'I'` with bit 7 set. That high bit *is* the terminator; `fcs` is not
NUL-terminated. (The `C9` at `$0C` is unrelated - that one is the low byte
of the data size.)
